items.text: Among adults ventilated for more than 48 hours in the unit since March 2025, is the number of missed mobilisation days among the first five eligible days associated with ICU-acquired weakness at ICU discharge, after accounting for illness severity and deep sedation?
items.population: Adults ventilated over 48 hours with an MRC sum score at discharge
items.time: First five eligible days; weakness at ICU discharge

finer: Feasible from the clinical information system with the research nurse's time; interesting to the unit and director; novel for partial adherence; ethical with an approved waiver; relevant to staffing decisions.
summary: One PECO question for the nested case-control study.
